content.short: Catizen is a cat-themed Web3 gaming ecosystem on Mantle where players earn real token airdrops through mini-games in a Meow Metaverse.
content.description: Catizen is a viral Web3 gaming ecosystem built around cat-themed gameplay and the Meow Metaverse, originally launched as a Telegram mini-app before expanding to on-chain infrastructure on the Mantle Network. Players engage with mini-games, complete tasks, and accumulate points that convert into real token airdrops, attracting millions of users through its accessible, mobile-first design. The project has received EcoFund support from Mantle for its contribution to onboarding new users to the ecosystem at scale.
content.meta: Catizen is a cat-themed Web3 gaming platform on Mantle where players earn through the Meow Metaverse. Discover Catizen on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
